newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish S-E-Banken says market share trend good.
newsitem.headline: Swedish S-E-Banken says market share trend good.

text.p: Swedish high street bank S-E-Banken said on Friday that market share developments for its core products in 1996 had been strong and the bank has a strong platform for future growth.
The bank posted a 68 percent jump in its operating profit to a record 5.87 billion crowns, slightly higher than market expectations of a profit of 5.68 percent.
The bank said this was its highest profit in its 25-year history and achieved due to falling interest rates, declining lending losses and growing volumes in important areas.
"S-E-Banken's reported return on equity (of 22.7 percent) is high in a European bank perspective," the bank's chief executive Bjorn Svedberg said in a statement.
"Our core products are developing well in terms of market share," he said.
Svedberg said the bank's Nordic expansion had been quite successful in Norway and Finland and was further strengthened this year by establishing a branch in Denmark.
"We now have a firm basis to act from in the future," Svedberg said.

"Our main strategy is to continue investing in our core products in the Nordic region and internationally. Our focus on strong customer segments is supported by sophisticated IT-systems to further advance our leading position."
